Metadata.title: ProjectB · Personal finance and budgeting
Metadata.description: Track your accounts, credit card instalments and monthly budget in one place.

Common.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this? This cannot be undone.

Landing.title: Know where your money goes.
Landing.subtitle: Track your accounts, credit card instalments and monthly budget in one place.

accounts.title: All accounts in one place
accounts.description: See cash, bank, credit card and savings balances side by side.

cards.title: Instalments and statements
cards.description: Instalment purchases are split across months; statement and due dates are tracked.

budgets.title: Budgets by category
budgets.description: Set a monthly limit per category and see what is left at a glance.

currencies.title: Multiple currencies
currencies.description: Lira, dollar, euro and pound accounts combined at current exchange rates.

Dashboard.emptyDescription: Your summary will appear here once you add accounts and transactions.
Dashboard.netWorthTrend: Net worth over the last 12 months

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: The page you are looking for may have moved or never existed.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.description: Create your free account in seconds.
signup.checkEmail: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to activate your account.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, we sent a reset link. Check your inbox.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account.

Auth.linkError: This link is invalid or has expired. Please try again.

Errors.passwordTooLong: Password can be at most 72 characters.

Errors.weakPassword: This password is too weak, choose a stronger one.

Errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

Errors.userAlreadyExists: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.
Errors.sameAccount: The two accounts must be different.
Errors.amountNotPositive: The amount must be greater than zero.

Errors.tagTooLong: A tag can be at most 30 characters.
Errors.tooManyTags: You can add at most 10 tags.
Errors.categoryNesting: Subcategories cannot have their own subcategories.
Errors.accountHasTransactions: This account has transactions and cannot be deleted. You can archive it instead.
Errors.invalidInstallments: Invalid installments. Installments are only available for credit card expenses.

Settings.profileDescription: Your name, interface language and the main currency used in reports.
Settings.baseCurrencyHint: Accounts in other currencies are converted to this one in reports.
Settings.categoriesDescription: Edit your income and expense categories and tags.
Settings.uiModeHint: The simple interface shows only the essentials; none of your data is removed.

Accounts.name: Account name
Accounts.openingBalanceHint: The balance before today. Use a minus sign for credit card debt (e.g. -2,500).
Accounts.currencyLocked: The currency cannot change once the account has transactions.
Accounts.emptyDescription: Start by adding a cash, bank or credit card account.
Accounts.archiveHint: Archived accounts are hidden from lists and the new transaction form; their history stays.
Accounts.cardSettingsHint: Statement amounts and due dates are calculated from these.
Accounts.minPaymentRateHint: The minimum share of the statement your bank asks for, often 20 or 40.
Accounts.spendableHint: Counted in what you can safely spend until payday. Savings accounts are usually left out.

Transactions.toAmountHint: The accounts use different currencies; enter the amount the receiving account gets.
Transactions.tagsHint: Separate with commas, e.g. holiday, work
Transactions.emptyDescription: Add your first income or expense.
Transactions.needAccount: Create an account before adding transactions.
Transactions.saved: Transaction saved. You can add the next one.

Categories.title: Categories
Categories.description: Group your income and expenses. You can rename or archive the default categories.
Categories.name: Name
Categories.archiveHint: Archived categories cannot be picked for new transactions; past transactions keep them. Subcategories are archived too.
Categories.tagsDescription: Tags are created while adding transactions. Deleting a tag removes it from transactions.

Card.setupDescription: Enter the statement day and payment due day to see statements and due dates.
Card.noDebt: Nothing is due on this statement.
Card.currentPeriodHint: Activity that will go on the statement of {date}.
Card.upcomingHint: What existing installment purchases will add to each statement.
Card.daysLeft: {days, plural, =0 {Due today} one {# day left} other {# days left}}

Rates.title: Exchange rates
Rates.description: TCMB's daily forex buying rates. Amounts in other currencies are converted to your main currency with these.
Rates.stale: Rates could not be updated; using rates from {date}.
Rates.none: No exchange rates yet; amounts in other currencies are left out of totals.
Rates.missing: Some currencies have no rate; those accounts are left out of the total.

Recurring.title: Recurring transactions
Recurring.description: Regular transactions like salary, rent or subscriptions are added automatically when due.
Recurring.pastStart: The start is in the past: transactions up to today are created too.
Recurring.resumeHint: When resumed, dates missed while paused are skipped.
Recurring.deleteHint: Transactions the rule already created are kept.
Recurring.emptyDescription: Enter your salary, rent or subscriptions once and they are added every period.

Budgets.title: Budgets
Budgets.description: Set a monthly spending limit per category. A parent category's budget includes its subcategories.
Budgets.fromMonth: Applies from {month} on; earlier months stay as they were.
Budgets.perDay: {amount} a day until the end of the month
Budgets.unbudgetedHint: Spending this month in categories you have not budgeted.
Budgets.removeHint: Removes this category's budget from {month} on; earlier months stay as they were.
Budgets.emptyDescription: Set monthly limits for groceries, eating out, transport and more; you will see a warning here and on the dashboard as you get close or go over.
Budgets.noCategories: Every expense category already has a budget.
Budgets.missingRates: Some spending is left out of the totals because its exchange rate is unknown.

Goals.title: Savings goals
Goals.description: Track how much you have put aside for a holiday, a home, an emergency fund and more.
Goals.name: Goal name
Goals.accountHint: Linked to an account, progress is that account's balance and the goal uses its currency.
Goals.monthlyNeeded: {amount} a month to make it by {date}
Goals.tracksAccount: This goal follows the balance of {account}. Progress grows as you move money into it.
Goals.archiveHint: Archived goals stay at the bottom of the list; you can restore them at any time.
Goals.deleteHint: Deleting the goal also deletes its contributions. A linked account and its transactions are not affected.
Goals.emptyDescription: Set a goal to see how much is left and how much to put aside each month to make the target date.

Reports.title: Reports
Reports.description: See how your income, spending and net worth change over time.
Reports.noPrevious: No data in the previous period
Reports.cashFlowHint: {granularity, select, day {Daily} other {Monthly}} totals. Installments count in the month they are paid; transfers are left out.
Reports.netWorthHint: All account balances added up, card debt subtracted. Other currencies are converted at the latest rates.

CashFlow.title: Cash flow
CashFlow.description: See how much you can spend until payday and what your money looks like after upcoming payments.
CashFlow.daysToPayday: {days, plural, =1 {1 day to payday} other {# days to payday}}
CashFlow.daysToMonthEnd: {days, plural, =1 {1 day to the end of the month} other {# days to the end of the month}}
CashFlow.safeTotalMonth: {amount} in total until the end of the month
CashFlow.shortfallMonth: {amount} short before the end of the month
CashFlow.noPayday: Add your salary as recurring income to plan around your payday.
CashFlow.noAccounts: No spendable account yet. Add a cash or bank account, or mark an account as spendable.
CashFlow.upcomingEmpty: No planned payments in the coming days.
CashFlow.calendarHint: Regular income and payments and card payments in the next {days} days. Each row shows the expected balance after it.
CashFlow.accountsHint: Only money in these accounts counts as spendable. Edit an account to change this.
CashFlow.regularHint: Salary, rent, bills and subscriptions are what the forecast is built on.
CashFlow.missingRates: Some amounts are left out because their exchange rate is unknown.
CashFlow.howItWorks: After planned payments, the lowest balance you reach before payday is what you can safely spend. Spending you have not planned is not predicted.

Welcome.title: How do you want to use the app?
Welcome.description: You can change this at any time in Settings; your data stays the same.
Welcome.simpleText: What you can spend, upcoming payments, transactions and goals. Everything else stays out of the way.
Welcome.detailedText: All of that plus budgets, reports, recurring transactions and every detail.

Envelopes.title: Envelopes for future costs
Envelopes.hint: For rare payments like insurance, taxes, repairs or a holiday. The money stays in your account; the share to set aside no longer counts as spendable.
Envelopes.name: What for?
Envelopes.paidHint: Mark it once you have paid: a repeating envelope starts saving for the next payment, a one-time envelope is archived. Remember to add the payment as a transaction too.
Envelopes.empty: No envelopes yet. Spread a big payment like yearly insurance over the months before it.
Envelopes.deleteHint: Money in a deleted envelope counts as spendable again.

WhatIf.title: What if I buy this?
WhatIf.hint: See what a purchase does to the days until payday, your card payments and your goals. Nothing is saved.
WhatIf.fits: This purchase fits in what you have until payday.
WhatIf.fitsMonth: This purchase fits in what you have until the end of the month.
WhatIf.short: If you buy it, your balance goes below zero on {date}.
WhatIf.goalUnknown: {name}: cannot be estimated without a saving history
WhatIf.goalHint: Based on how much you saved on average in recent months.
